content: Hello, I am Vector Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Remy Oak?
Yes, this is Remy Oak speaking.
First, I need to ask you two security questions. Please tell me your member code.
Correct. What is your year of birth?
Thank you. I'm calling about overdue payments on your account. Your credit card has 1210.05 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount today?
I can't pay the full amount today, I'm afraid. I could pay 420.50 on October fifteenth.
On which day can you pay 1210.05?
I'm not able to commit to a date for the full 1210.05 right now. What I can do is 420.50 on October fifteenth.
To confirm: the credit card, 420.50 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Do you confirm this? Please say yes to confirm.
Could you repeat just the amount, including the pence?
The amount is 420.50. To confirm: the credit card, 420.50 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Do you confirm this? Please say yes to confirm.
Thank you, I heard it that time: 420 pounds and 50 pence. Yes, I confirm 420.50 on the credit card on Thursday 15 October 2026.
Your promise is recorded: the credit card, 420.50 on Thursday 15 October 2026. The record is available in the secure portal. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything, thank you. Goodbye.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
